external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The authentication used by the serial console is not stated.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A customer associated with an installed sensor node and its telemetry.
external_entities.source_excerpt: to find out which customer the node belongs to

processes.name: sensor node
processes.description: A deployed sensor node that publishes readings over MQTT and polls for firmware images.
processes.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
processes.notes: The node is outside the organisation's physical control. The source does not state whether firmware images are signature-checked before installation.

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker run on GKE that accepts sensor readings and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE and expose to the internet

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that processes readings and writes them to the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used by the gateway to check the device key and identify the associated customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service receiving readings from the device gateway for consumption by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing sensor readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find
data_stores.notes: The bucket is publicly readable. The source does not state whether firmware images are signed.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the device registry to check its key and customer association.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings to Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the firmware bucket for a new firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over a local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what authentication, if any, the console has.

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views dashboards backed by BigQuery telemetry data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed and are outside the organisation's physical control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites. They are outside our physical control

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's analytics network where the telemetry normalizer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators access dashboards.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake's contents are confidential because it contains site addresses, occupancy patterns, and customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns and identifies the contents as customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware bucket's contents are public because the bucket is public read.
